plan.notes: Source: official Massasoit Community College 'Computer Science Transfer — Associate in Science' academic map, 'Entering Fall 2025', full-time enrollment (massasoit.edu official academic maps). Transcribed 2026-09-30 by hand directly from the PDF's term-by-term table; catalog year set to 2025-2026 from the map's 'Entering Fall 2025' stamp. Degree name is Massasoit's true program title: 'Computer Science Transfer', Associate in Science — a transfer-oriented AS designed for transfer to a four-year institution for a bachelor's in computer science. Caveats: (1) The map prints no course-level prerequisites (its KEY defines the 'o' symbol as 'no prerequisites or developmental courses required', which marks every course on this map; other prereq details live in Degree Works behind the student portal), so all prereq arrays are empty — none were inferred. (2) Milestone note transcribed: complete COSC 168 Advanced Java Programming and MATH 217 Precalculus (or higher) by the end of the second semester. (3) Semester 2 history elective is listed on the map as 4 credits; transcribed exactly as printed. (4) MATH 221 Calculus I is listed as 3 credits on the map; transcribed exactly as printed. (5) Map states a minimum of 63 credits and 19 courses is required for completion and that the same course may not satisfy two different requirements. Semester totals: 17 + 16 + 14 + 16 = 63 credits over 19 courses, matching the map's published minimum. (6) Upon completing COSC 157, COSC 168, and COSC 281 Intro to Software Design and Development, students may apply for the Java Programming certificate (certificate itself is not part of this degree plan). (7) MassTransfer STEM note: students intending the MassTransfer STEM block should select humanities electives, not general electives. (8) tccns/xfer left empty: the map names no destination-specific transfer mapping.

courses.title: Precalculus (or higher-level math course)
courses.choice_note: Map lists 'MATH 217 Precalculus or higher' — take MATH 217 or a higher-level math course per placement/advisor.

courses.title: History Elective
courses.choice_note: History elective. Map's eligible list: HIST 101 History of Western Civilization I, HIST 102 History of Western Civilization II, HIST 103 US History I, HIST 104 US History II, HIST 108 World History I, HIST 109 World History II, or HIST 131 The United States since 1945 (first of two history electives).
